acceptance_correction_history.reason: The accepted E2 implementation optimized only in-sample Student-t NLL. The frozen R4 preregistration requires Student-t NLL plus horizon CRPS plus a stability penalty, and its cross-fitted scale residuals must be produced by temporal folds without training on observations after a held-out row. The implementation used ordinary K-fold complements that include future rows.
